gloss: to do so; to do that; to do it that way

definitions.gloss: to do so; to do that; to do it that way
definitions.explanation: そう (so, that way) + する (to do). Refers back to an action just mentioned or suggested by the other person, instead of repeating it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧ならそうしない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I don't think I would do that.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。そうすれば⟦{安心|あんしん}できる→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧。
examples.english: You should talk to your teacher. If you do that, you'll feel better.

notes:
One of the こそあど set: こう⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do it this way), そうする (to do it that way, the way you said), ⟦ああ→ああ：01147_aa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do it like that), ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (what to do). そうする usually points to something the other person has just said or suggested.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- そうしよう / そうしましょう: let's do that
- そうする⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: then, in that case (also used as a conjunction)
- そうすれば: if you do that
- そうしたら: if you do that; and then

SIMILAR WORDS:
- そうして (conjunction): and then, in that way — a separate entry. As the て-form of そうする it keeps the full verb meaning: そうして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (while you do that).
